question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. Only three people have exams after R. P has the exam immediately after R, but before Q. S has the exam before U but after V. T has the exam on Sunday. How many people have exams between P and S?
solution:
**Given :** Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) Only three people have exams after R.

2) T has the exam on Sunday.
